messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine. If you are breastfeeding, tell your doctor if you notice symptoms in the baby such as agitation, sleep problems, feeding problems, or reduced weight gain.
methylphenidate is not approved for use by anyone younger than 6 years old.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
